control.name: Name
control.desc: The name of the locator assigned when the locator was built. It can be changed in the Catalog Pane.

control.name: Description
control.desc: The description of the locator.

control.name: Spatial reference
control.desc: The output spatial reference of the locator.

control.name: Release
control.desc: The release number of ArcGIS with which the locator was built.

control.name: ReleaseInfo
control.desc: The releaseInfo version of the locator.

control.name: Compatibility Release
control.desc: The oldest release version of ArcGIS with which the locator is compatible.

control.name: Last build time
control.desc: The date and time when the locator was built or rebuilt.

control.name: Supported Roles
control.desc: The roles used when the locator was built.

control.name: Supported Countries
control.desc: The countries that were included when the locator was built (can be overwritten in Geocoding Options).

control.name: Precision Type
control.desc: The precision type that was used to build the locator.

control.name: Primary Table(s)
control.desc: The tables used for reference data to build the locator.

section.name: Place name alias table
section.desc: Description of the place name alias table.

control.name: Alternate Table(s)
control.desc: The tables used for alternate data to build the locator.

section.name: Input address fields
section.desc: The input fields used for multiline batch geocoding.

control.name: Input Fields
control.desc: The input fields used for multiline batch geocoding.

section.name: Output fields
section.desc: The fields to return when geocoding.

control.name: Output Fields
control.desc: The fields to return when geocoding.

control.name: Reverse Output Fields
control.desc: The fields to return when reverse geocoding

section.name: Geocoding options
section.desc: Geocoding options that control how the locator finds and filters the list of candidates and how it places the locations of matched addresses.

control.name: Match out of range
control.desc: Indicates whether StreetAddress matches should allow the input house number to be slightly out of the address range.

control.name: Preferred location type
control.desc: The preferred output geometry for geocoding. Either side of street (routing location) or rooftop/parcel centroid (address location) to be used for PointAddress matches.

control.name: Minimum match score
control.desc: The minimum score a match candidate needs to be considered a match in batch geocoding.

control.name: Minimum candidate score
control.desc: The minimum score a potential match record requires to be considered a candidate for interactive geocoding.

control.name: Side offset
control.desc: The offset value in meters that determines the distance from either side of a line feature where a matched location should be placed.

control.name: End offset
control.desc: The offset value in meters that determines the distance away from the end of a line feature where a matched location should be placed.

control.name: Intersection connectors
control.desc: A list of characters, symbols, or words that will be used to overwrite the default values that are used to delimit two streets in an intersection address. Comma delimited within quotes. ("&", "|")

control.name: Match with no zones
control.desc: Searching and matching input addresses with no zone is allowed if this Property is set to Yes (Note that performance may be affected).

control.name: Comprehensive zone matching
control.desc: Allow addresses to match to cities that don't exactly match the input city name if this Property is set to Yes.

control.name: Return Collections
control.desc: Enable or disable return collections

control.name: Show suggestions for partial house numbers
control.desc: Enable or Disable whether partial house number suggestions are returned.

control.name: Show summary of subaddresses with base address suggestion
control.desc: Enable or Disable whether a summary of subaddresses are returned after entering the base address.

control.name: Suggestions for Subaddresses
control.desc: Choose the subaddress suggestion strategy to use.

control.name: Countries to support
control.desc: The countries that will be supported when geocoding with this locator.

control.name: Categories to support
control.desc: The categories that will be supported when geocoding with this locator.

control.name: Features to support for reverse geocoding
control.desc: The option allows you to choose the types of reverse geocodes that will be allowed by this locator. An application that wants to return addresses would select Point Address and Street Address but an application that only cares about getting the postal code description for a location would only choose Postal Code.

control.name: Return Input Location
control.desc: This property will change the default behavior of reverse geocoding to return the location of the original input point rather than the location of the match address.

control.name: Preferred city name
control.desc: The default city name value that is returned by the locator is configured differently for each country based on local knowledge. If there is a preference to get back a different city name value by default, you can use this option to overwrite the default value with one of the values defined below. If that city value does not exist in the data, the default city value for that country will be returned instead.

control.name: Preferred street name
control.desc: The default street name value returned by the locator is the value that is matched to in the data. This option allows you to overwrite the default so that the primary street name is always returned instead of the matched street name.

section.name: Performance
section.desc: Options for optimizing performance for interactive search for candidates or geocoding a table of addresses.

control.name: Number of threads
control.desc: Number of threads used for batch geocoding operation.

control.name: Maximum number of candidates
control.desc: The maximum number of candidates to be returned in interactive match or rematch.

control.name: Default number of suggest candidates
control.desc: The number of suggest candidates that are returned by default.

control.name: Maximum number of suggest candidates
control.desc: Maximum number of suggest candidates that can requested from the locator.

control.name: Name
control.desc: The name of the locator view.

control.name: URL
control.desc: The URL of the locator view.

control.name: Output Spatial Reference
control.desc: The output spatial reference of the locator view.
